assetBrief:
SUBJECT: the triangle as the rigid three-sided shape — a triangular plate with draggable vertices, live angle tags summing to 180°, and a press test showing rigidity.

GEOMETRY: A flat triangular plate standing on a base board. Its three vertices A, B, C are draggable dots; the plate and its three side strokes deform as they move. At each vertex a small arc and degree tag show the interior angle; a running total tag shows the sum always equal to 180°. A 'press test' button pushes on one side and the triangle holds rigid, while a companion 4-sided frame visibly sways for comparison. Presets morph the triangle into equilateral, isosceles, scalene, right.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) base board; (2) triangular plate; (3) vertices A, B, C; (4) angle arcs + total tag.

CAMERA: three-quarter from front-left, slightly above, frames plate and presets; labels legible. Budget 5-9k triangles. Named nodes: Board, TrianglePlate, SideStrokes, Vertex_A, Vertex_B, Vertex_C, AngleTags, TotalTag, PressTest. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
